name: System and certificate information
description: NTDS database size and LDAPS, MDI and Arc certificate validity.
kql:
SystemData_CL
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer
| project Timestamp = TimeGenerated, Computer, NTDSFileSizeinGB,
    LDAPSCertThumbprint = LDAPSCertificate.Thumbprint,
    LDAPSCertValidity = LDAPSCertificate.NotAfter,
    MDICertValidity = Certificates[0].NotAfter, ArcCertValidity = Certificates[1].NotAfter
